Name: Whalesong
Description: Whalesong was a half-Atlantean girl who was involved in a boating accident when she was younger and almost drowned. Luckily, a telepathic sea creature, named Leviathan, had been following her saved her. She formed a close bond with the creature and has lived with it for so long that she is now incapable of human speech.
